description: Create a webhook inbox. Returns its ingest URL and a read token (shown once). The same slug is the inbox email address <slug>@ahook.app. Optional slug: a branded username for the inbox (3-63 lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens) — any account may pick one, including anonymous-free via MCP; the inbox never expires by default, so the slug is permanent — pass expires_in_seconds (60-2592000) for an ephemeral inbox, deleted at expiry, freeing its slug. Reserved names are rejected (invalid_slug) and a taken name returns slug_taken.

expires_in_seconds.description: Optional lifetime in seconds, 60-2592000 (60s-30d). The inbox is deleted at expiry. Free for every inbox.

slug.description: Optional username slug for the inbox (e.g. vintagefinds). Any account may pick one, including anonymous-free via MCP; the inbox never expires by default, so the slug is permanent unless expires_in_seconds is set.

name: create_inbox
